parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a toilet, typically made of durable plastic. It covers the tank or bowl when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: The lid serves to cover the toilet tank or bowl, maintaining hygiene and aesthetic appearance. It can be lifted or closed easily.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged and can rotate upward or downward around the hinge axis.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of ceramic material. It includes the bowl and the tank structure.
parts.Functional_description: The base body supports the user’s weight, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains stationary once installed.
